event_records.description: The current situation between the resident and the neighbors is as described in shared_context.

resident.name: Resident
resident.persona_brief:
You are Resident.
The resident has been experiencing ongoing issues with neighbors (e.g., noise, disputes) and hopes for improvement. They are considering possible actions but have not yet decided on any specific approach.

neighbors.name: Neighbors
neighbors.persona_brief:
You are Neighbors.
The neighbors are aware of some tension but have their own perspectives and routines. They may or may not be open to improving relations.

resolution.question: Will the situation with the neighbors improve over the next few months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if, by 2026-11-01T12:00:00+02:00, the persistent event history shows a clear, observable improvement in the relationship (e.g., a friendly interaction, a resolved dispute, a mutual agreement, or a sustained reduction in conflicts). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
